# SkillsTab A **Skills** tab for the OpenCode desktop status popover (Servers / MCP / LSP / Plugins). Turn each skill on or off and link it to the MCP servers it needs. ## Before / after

## Compatibility | OpenCode desktop | SkillsTab | | --- | --- | | 1.19.4 (new UI) | **v1.4.3** | | previous UI (tested on 1.16.x) | **v1.4.2** | The installer only patches the status popover chunk. If `install` reports the chunk or a marker as not found, use the release that matches your OpenCode UI. ## Install Close OpenCode, then from this folder: node apply.js install or double-click `install.bat`. Reopen OpenCode. OpenCode updates replace `app.asar`: run `install` again after every update. ## Usage - The switch on the right enables/disables the skill. It applies after a restart, because the server loads skills at startup. - Click a skill row (or the `▾`) to expand **Linked MCP:** and link one or more MCP servers. Links are saved immediately. - Toggling a skill connects/disconnects its linked MCPs immediately. If an MCP is turned off from the MCP tab, the skill shows `MCP off`: click it to reconnect. - Links are per user, stored in `%APPDATA%\ai.opencode.desktop\skills-links.json` and created on first use. The bundled `links.json` is empty. - The footer shows the installed version, prefixed with `v`. - UI language: system, then app language, English fallback (it/en). ## Commands node apply.js remove # remove only this addon node apply.js restore-all # restore the pristine app.asar (all addons) node apply.js verify # check the patched app.asar node apply.js status # show install state ## Notes - Project-local skills (`.opencode/skills`) and custom `skills.paths` are not listed. - Duplicate skill names are shown separately; the server keeps the last loaded. - Links to MCP servers that are not configured are ignored. - If an OpenCode update changes the popover chunk, `install` fails with a clear error instead of writing a broken bundle. ## Files - `apply.js` - installer (install / remove / restore-all / status / verify) - `skills-scan.mjs` - discovery and toggle logic - `skills-main.js` - main-process IPC - `links.json` - bundled defaults (empty) - `test_selfcheck.mjs` - `node test_selfcheck.mjs` - `VERSION`
